## Quick exploration of frequencies of values for each variable

```{r}

data_prep <- tar_read(data_prep)
data_prep |>
    map(tabyl)

data_imp <- tar_read(data_imp)
data_imp[[1]] |>
    map(tabyl)

```

## Regression models

### Model 1A

```{r}

fit_model1A <- tar_read(fit_model1A)

summary(fit_model1A)

check_diag_measures(fit_model1A)


```

### Model comparison

```{r}

fit_model1A <- brms::add_criterion(fit_model1A, "loo")

fit_model1B <- brms::add_criterion(fit_model1B, "loo")

brms::loo_compare(fit_model1A, fit_model1B)

# loo(fit_model1A, moment_match = TRUE)
loo(fit_model1A, reloo = TRUE)

```
